title: Apply for a customer number with Transport for NSW (organisations)
summary: Organisations must apply for a customer number with Transport for NSW before they can register vehicles.
intro:
Vehicles can be registered by individuals or organisations. Organisations first need to be assigned a customer number.

An authorised representative needs to apply at a service centre and bring the required documentation.
who_can_apply: Organisations that need to register vehicles.
what_you_need: The completed PDF form: TfNSW Customer Number Application (Organisation) (https://tfnswforms.transport.nsw.gov.au/45071266-customer-number-application.pdf)
For incorporated companies: An Australian Securities and Investments Commission document confirming the organisation's details, including the ACN or ABN.
For other incorporated bodies: Refer to the details on the form.
The authorised representative's proof of identity (if applicable).
If you are a motor dealer: Your dealer's licence.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete TfNSW Customer Number Application (Organisation) – PDF.
Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Submit your application at a service centre.

internal_links.text: Apply for a customer number with Transport for NSW (individuals)

faqs.a: Organisations need to be assigned a customer number before they can register vehicles.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a customer number?
faqs.a: An authorised representative must apply at a service centre.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to bring?
faqs.a: You need the completed application form, required documentation (such as an ASIC document for incorporated companies), and proof of identity for the authorised representative.
